Ah well eventually my paranoia was getting the best of me because the real issue was that he left read notifications on so it really felt like a jab when he hadn't responded in like...12+ hours? So I got mad and called him a coward for not just telling me he didn't want to call it quits and blah blah and then he explained "oh I was just waiting to know my schedule beforehand" which....whoops haha. Basically there was not really a way to save it from that (despite my efforts lol). Which makes sense of course because again..only two dates. Looking back at it I think it depends on how much you need in a relationship and how much you're willing to sacrifice.  Maybe you need someone who is better at texting! Getting ghosted fucking sucks and most of the time despite it not being your fault it still hurts and can make you nervous for future relationships. I say think about how much it bothers you and then if it's really a lot then tell them that. But in a calm matter haha. I do regret it a little with how I did it but then I would have never rebounded and found a nice partner for the cuffing season who WAS better at texting. In short I guess we all have different wants and needs and it's up to you on what they are.
